name: hidden_stems
lineage: 人元司令分野, 《淵海子平》「又論節氣歌」 as tabulated by 徐樂吾
source: Stems and day counts: 《淵海子平》卷一「又論節氣歌」 (假如子上十日壬，中旬下旬方是癸 ...), read on 2026-10-13 at donglishuzhai.net/chapter/12807.html. The order in which the stems take command within the month: 徐樂吾《子平真詮評註》「十二月令人元司令分野表」, read only in a repost at blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_4a66051f01010kl2.html.
notes: A different kind of table: which stem commands the month on which days after its node term, so each branch holds every stem that has a turn. Six branches hold a stem the verse table does not: 子 壬, 卯 甲, 午 丙, 酉 庚, 亥 戊, 申 己. Not verified because the order of command rests on a repost of 徐樂吾, not his book. The two sources differ at 午: the verse gives 丁 ten days (丙 10, 丁 10, 己 9, a month of 29), 徐樂吾 eleven; his is used. For 申 徐樂吾 writes 戊己土 ten days together; the verse splits them 己 7, 戊 3. 《三命通會》「論人元司事」 gives yet another division (寅: 土 5, 丙 5, 甲 20 ...) and quotes 醉醒子 against counting days at all. Under "branches" the principal stem, the one that commands last and longest, is first.
order: principal (本氣) first, then the others in the order they command
commandOrder: from the node term that opens the month: stem, days
